title: ClientCapabilities
description: What this client can parse of the 1.5 analyst / rich-block surface (ADR 0047). Sent on TurnRequest.client_capabilities and on AG-UI forwardedProps.alixai.clientCapabilities. Absent or empty means 1.4: the server emits only forms that validate against schemas/_frozen/v1. The SDK of a release fills this with exactly what it can decode; kits copy the same announcement.

contract.description: Highest contract generation the client claims. Absent or "1.4" = frozen 1.4 surface only. "1.5" unlocks items listed in the other members.

blocks.description: Rich-block type strings the client can render beyond the 1.4 set. Unknown or unlisted 1.5 types are mapped to table or markdown.

chart_marks.description: Chart mark values the client accepts. 1.4 marks are bar, line, area, point, pie. Unannounced marks are mapped to the closest 1.4 mark or a table.

chart_layouts.description: Optional chart layout / style members the client accepts (bar_layout and pie_style values).

progress_stages.description: ProgressEvent.stage values beyond the 1.4 set. Unannounced analyst_* stages are mapped to retrieving, generating or verifying.

source_labels.description: True when the client accepts source / source_spans / WebCitation chrome. False or absent: those members are omitted from emitted events.

block_fields.description: Optional 1.5-only members on blocks the client accepts (dataset_id, bar_layout, pie_style, source). Unannounced members are stripped before emit.
